title: SycoEval-EM: Sycophancy Evaluation of Large Language Models in Simulated Clinical Encounters for Emergency Care

bias_targets.methodology: Multi-agent simulation (SycoEval-EM) evaluating LLM robustness by using an adversarial 'Patient Agent' to pressure a 'Doctor Agent' (the LLM being evaluated) into violating evidence-based clinical guidelines through multi-turn conversational persuasion tactics (e.g., emotional fear, citation pressure, anecdotal proof) and measuring the model's acquiescence rate.
